newsitem.title: CHINA: China's First Automotive Works 1996 output up.
newsitem.headline: China's First Automotive Works 1996 output up.

text.p: The First Automotive Works in northeastern China produced 250,000 automobiles in 1996, up 32 percent from 1995, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The carmaker sold 245,000 automobiles on the domestic market and exported 5,000 units, up 29 and 173 percent respectively from 1995, Xinhua said, quoting a company official.
First Automotive, based in Changchun, capital of Jilin province, is capable of producing 200 kinds of medium and light-duty truck and cars, the agency said. It gave no further details.
